create.name: Dimitri Moraitis
create.bio:
Dimitri Moraitis is an American metaphysical teacher and writer, and co-founder and spiritual director of the Spiritual Arts Institute, a non-profit school in Encinitas, California, that teaches meditation with Divine Light, the study of the aura and what it calls the Kingdom of Light teachings. Before turning to spiritual work he trained in film and television and was nominated for an Academy Award for a short film. A strong spiritual awakening in his mid-twenties led him, a year or so later, to the clairvoyant teacher Barbara Y. Martin, who trained him in metaphysics and later chose him to carry her mission forward.

Together they wrote a series of books on the aura and the inner life, starting with Change Your Aura, Change Your Life and going on to Karma and Reincarnation, Communing with the Divine and Heaven and Your Spiritual Evolution, and they founded the institute after the first of these appeared. He helped design its courses, including the long Seven Spiritual Arts training, in which he leads the weekly live sessions. He also gives evening workshops online and at the Encinitas centre, guiding colour-ray meditations and drawing on myth and mysticism, and he speaks widely on podcasts and radio.

books.title: Change Your Aura, Change Your Life
books.author: Barbara Y. Martin and Dimitri Moraitis
books.description: The co-authors' first book and the basis of their school's teaching: a step-by-step guide to the human aura and to meditating with coloured rays of spiritual light, now in its third edition.

books.title: Karma and Reincarnation
books.author: Barbara Y. Martin and Dimitri Moraitis
books.description: A clairvoyant account of rebirth and the soul's long series of lives, and of how karma shapes the life being lived now.

books.title: Communing with the Divine
books.author: Barbara Y. Martin and Dimitri Moraitis
books.description: A guide to angels, archangels and the wider spiritual hierarchy, illustrated with fine-art plates, and to building a working relationship with them.

books.title: Heaven and Your Spiritual Evolution
books.author: Barbara Y. Martin and Dimitri Moraitis
books.description: A mystic's map of the afterlife and the heavenly realms, and of what they suggest about growing towards one's highest potential in this life.

courses.title: Seven Spiritual Arts Program
courses.description: The institute's main training, running for two and a half years, with weekly live metaphysical sessions led by Dimitri, group meditations, class recordings and small breakout groups with faculty.

courses.title: Change Your Aura, Change Your Life Six-Week Course
courses.description: A six-week introduction to meditating with Divine Light, built on the co-authors' first book, with their training videos, a meditation manual and live weekly sessions, offered online and in Encinitas each quarter.

courses.title: Change Your Aura, Change Your Life Workshop
courses.description: An online evening workshop in which Dimitri guides a Divine Light meditation for the aura and talks about its structure, the chakras and the rhythms of spiritual life.

courses.title: Myth & Metaphysics
courses.description: A two-hour afternoon workshop, in Encinitas and online, reading Homer's Odyssey as a map of the soul's journey home, with guided light meditations.
